prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right choice depends on the style of ad you need, your budget, where you’ll run the ad, and how much customization you want.

Quick recommendations by use-case
- Human presenter / corporate ads: Synthesia — best for realistic AI presenters and many languages; great when you want a person-on-screen without shooting video.
- Fast social/video-clip ads from scripts or blog posts: Pictory or Lumen5 — good for turning text/long videos into short social ads with automated storyboards and captions.
- Template-driven social and ad creative, easy branding: Canva (video) or InVideo — best for quick turnarounds, many templates and aspect ratios for Facebook/Instagram/YouTube/Stories.
- Short-form, repurposed clips optimized for Reels/TikTok: Opus Clip / Vidyo.ai (and Clipchamp’s tools) — they focus on cutting long-form into high-engagement shorts.
- Animated explainer/product ads: Vyond or Animaker — strong for animated characters, infographics and whiteboard-style ads.
- Creative editing / advanced generative effects: Runway — for experimental, visually distinctive ads and advanced AI video editing.
- E‑commerce / scalable ad templates for campaigns: Shakr or Promo.com — built for large ad campaigns with multiple variants and platform specs.

How to pick the “best” for you
- Want a realistic spokesperson without filming? Choose Synthesia / HeyGen / Elai.io.
- Need to repurpose webinar/long-form content into many short cuts with captions? Choose Pictory or Lumen5.
- Need fast, templated social ads with brand kits? Choose Canva or InVideo.
- Need animation/illustration style? Choose Vyond/Animaker.
- Need creative, cutting-edge visuals or object-level edits? Try Runway.
- Are you running many ad variants and A/B tests? Pick platforms with batch export and ad-platform integrations (Shakr, Promo).

Factors to check before deciding
- Output formats and aspect ratios (vertical for Reels/TikTok, square for Instagram).
- Voice options, language support and lip-sync quality (if using AI presenters).
- Branding features: custom fonts/colors/logos and templates.
- Asset import (CSV/bulk) if you’ll produce many variants.
- Collaboration features and cloud export speed.
- Pricing model: per-video, subscription, or credits; trial availability.

If you tell me:
- the platform(s) you’ll advertise on (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, connected TV),
- style (live presenter, animated, text + stock footage),
- how many variants you need and your budget,
I’ll recommend the single best tool and a short workflow to make the ad quickly.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
